exchangeFormat: NE: RST(optional) + NE county. Non-NE US/Canada: RST + state/province. DX: RST + DXCC country. CW/Phone/Digital (RTTY/PSK; NOT FT8/FT4 — separate competition). All non-WARC HF + VHF/UHF. NE works everyone; non-NE works NE only.

scoringRules.scoreFormula: Σ QSO pts × Σ geo mults (counted ONCE PER CONTEST — not per band, not per mode) + station bonuses. Pts: Digital 1, Phone 2, CW 3 (RTTY=Digital). NE entrant geo mult = each NE county + each US state + each Canadian province + each DXCC country worked. Non-NE entrant geo mult = NE counties only (max 93). NE works everyone; non-NE scores NE contacts only. Mobile/portable county-change = new QSO + new county credit. Station bonuses (once each): KA0BOJ +100, K0SMM/K0RPT/K0NEB/NF0N/N0FER/KE0XQ +50 each. Claimed/running — Nebraska QSO Party committee re-adjudicates. NOT applied (category/self-report, off-log): Power Multiplier (×5 QRP / ×2 <100W / ×1 >100W, default ×1); RARE GRID activator bonus (DN91CE/DE/EE — entrant's own grid, not log-derivable); Satellite category (4 pts/QSO — declared overlay). The separate FT8/FT4 grid-square competition is a distinct entry/log and is intentionally NOT scored here.
